oracle.ref: PR #1698 (feat); fix evidence: Plan tasks/todo-wo-public-demos.md part A and the council review A2-A4: a self-hosted Website Opportunities needs an account-level credential, and seat keys must keep their one-site fence.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# skipped 0', and '# pass' equal to '# tests'. Every named case is 'ok': /oauth/device/code answers an eight-consonant XXXX-XXXX user code, verification_uri <origin>/connect, interval 5, expires_in 600 and refuses another client or scope; discovery names the device endpoint and grant; /connect sends a signed-out visitor to /login and back, shows the account and the code to compare, and a cross-origin POST decides nothing; polls answer authorization_pending, slow_down (+5 s each), access_denied, expired_token, and a spent device code is invalid_grant and revokes its grant; ten tries per account and address then 429; a demos token reads /v1/me as {email, displayName} and gets 403 ACCOUNT_TOKEN_NOT_ALLOWED on /v1/sites routes, while requireAccountToken refuses a seat key 403 ACCOUNT_TOKEN_REQUIRED; refresh keeps the token id and rotates both secrets, a replayed refresh revokes the grant (KEY_REVOKED); /oauth/revoke and DELETE /api/me/connected-apps/:id both end the connection and another account can neither list nor delete it; the Settings section lists the app with Create demo sites and Disconnect.
